paragraphs: The Paris Court of Appeal has agreed with the decision that far-right leader Marine Le Pen is guilty of misusing EU funds, but it reduced her punishment.

Her original five-year ban from public office was shortened, which means she can legally run in the April 2027 French presidential election. However, the judge also decided she must stay under house arrest for one year and wear an electronic ankle tag. This creates a major political problem – Le Pen has repeatedly stated she will refuse to run if she is forced to wear a tag, and she claims she wouldn’t feel free to campaign or meet voters normally.

Political experts suggest that if Le Pen decides to step down because of this situation, her young partner, Jordan Bardella, will likely take her place as the party’s presidential candidate and launch a completely new political strategy for the election.

a legal punishment where a person is not allowed to leave their home, instead of going to a real prison
a small electronic object attached to a person’s body so that the police know exactly where they are

paragraphs: A French court decided that political leader Marine Le Pen is guilty of taking public money, but the court changed her punishment.
Her old five-year ban from politics is now over, so she can legally run in the next presidential election in April 2027.

But there is still a big problem. The judge said Le Pen has to stay at home for one year and wear an electronic tag on her leg. Le Pen said before that she would not run for president if she had to wear this tag because she cannot travel and talk to people normally.
Now, Le Pen’s political party must hold a special meeting. If she decides to step down, her young partner Jordan Bardella will probably become the new candidate for the election.

paragraphs: A court in Paris says that Marine Le Pen is guilty. She takes money from the EU. But the court changes her punishment.

Now, she can legally run in the election for president in April 2027. But she has a new problem. She must stay at home for one year and wear a special electronic device on her leg. Le Pen says that she hates this device. She will not run if she must wear it. She wants to meet with people face-to-face.
If she stops, a young man from her party, Jordan Bardella, will try to become the new president of France.
